name: page-head
title: Page head
description: The site's page head: the page title as the section head with its lines breaking from 768, a lead in the soft gray, a White and a quiet button (or a control in the White one's place), and an ASCII drift in the right columns or fading in from the edge when centered. The error head is the same with a retry button.
use_for: The top of an inner page (resources, use cases, legal, coming soon, 404 and error pages); `align="centre"` for pricing-style pages; `control` to put a connect menu or a form in the White button's place; `visual` for your own picture on the right.
never: More than one White button: with a control, the White button is left out
A display-size title: page heads use the section head (56px at most)
Moving drifts: the texture holds still
source: Site pages/PageHead (PageHead.tsx, ErrorHead.tsx, PageHead.module.css) and ui/AsciiDrift: 64px above (96 at 768, 128 at 1024), 80 below (96 at 768); .t-head title; 24px between the title and the body; .t-lead in --text-2 at 640px; actions 40px below, 12px apart, stacked on phones; margin: 7fr and 5fr columns from 768 (48px apart, 64 from 1024), the cluster crop at -64px top and bottom, at least 160px tall; centre: the mass crop from the right, from 1024, half the width less 320px

props.name: id
props.description: Names the heading (`<id>-heading`) the section is labeled by.

props.name: lines
props.description: The title, one string per line (lines break from 768).

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: The capital label over the title.

props.name: primary
props.description: The White button. Left out when there is a `control`.

props.name: control
props.description: A control in the White button's place (a connect menu, a sign-up form).

props.name: pair
props.description: On phones, hide the control and turn the quiet button White (the site's MCP pair). False keeps both.

props.name: align
props.description: margin (copy left, drift right) or centre.

props.name: visual
props.description: Your own picture in the right columns instead of the drift (margin only).

props.name: drift
props.description: The ASCII drift in the right columns when there is no `visual` (margin only).

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the White button is pressed.

examples.name: Margin
examples.label: Copy left, drift right
examples.content:
<!-- An inner page's head: the copy on the left, the ASCII drift on the right, a White and a quiet button. -->
<spyglass-page-head head-id="resources" lines='["Resources"]' lead="Templates, writing and docs for building on Acme." primary='{"label":"Get a free API key","href":"#"}' secondary='{"label":"Read the docs","href":"#"}'></spyglass-page-head>

examples.name: Centre
examples.label: Centered
examples.content:
<!-- A centered head over two lines, the texture fading in from the right edge from 1024. -->
<spyglass-page-head head-id="pricing" lines='["Simple pricing,","for every team"]' lead="Start free. Pay as you grow, and cancel anytime." align="centre"></spyglass-page-head>

examples.name: Control
examples.label: With the connect menu
examples.content:
<!-- A use case's head with the connect menu in the White button's place; on phones it steps aside for a White button. -->
<spyglass-page-head head-id="agents" lines='["Acme for agents"]' lead="Give any agent live answers from Acme in one step." secondary='{"label":"Get a free API key","href":"#"}'><spyglass-connect-menu slot="control"></spyglass-connect-menu></spyglass-page-head>
